summary: Executable On1x-native SDK value modules and a canonical-on1xc C11 reference analyzer are available through an explicitly trusted, statically allowlisted scalar bridge. General ABI 2 host bindings, DSO/worker loading, structured compiler snapshots, foreign resources, callbacks, and sandboxed execution remain unsupported.

facilities.subset: Statuses including exact ABI-v1 values 0..7, bounded trivial Result values, generation-ID byte/text views, diagnostics, immutable program snapshots, copied extension metadata, host capability queries, lifecycle/cancellation/work budgets, and host-staged candidates

On1x-authored deterministic source-byte analyzer compiled by canonical on1xc through C11 and invoked by a trusted static host profile; emits revision-validated diagnostics and a host-validated six-byte candidate

Owned bridge ABI 1 over u8/u32/u64 only, generation32-slot32 IDs, copied host storage, owner/kind/state/revision checks, fixed limits, transactional metadata initialization, reverse compensation, cancellation, and atomic in-memory publication
blockers: Public SDK ABI 2 host table is absent in the baseline
The generated On1x function symbol is compiler-revision-bound rather than a stable exported AOT module ABI
The profile is trusted and single-thread-confined, not isolated
No isolated worker adapter for generated On1x modules
No structured AST/HIR/MIR host snapshot bindings

behavioral_coverage: positive canonical On1x check, C11 emission, strict C compilation, linking, and execution
ABI and independently versioned source/candidate/adapter schema mismatch
candidate output limit exhaustion distinct from cancellation
stale, forged, wrong-owner, and wrong-kind handles
typed rejection of string use on a u8 adapter and candidate/program nominal kind confusion
invalid UTF-8, invalid spans, and bounded related diagnostics
diagnostic sink and publication failure with no leaked live object or partial candidate
busy destruction, lifecycle order, cleanup, and generation advance
ABI-v1 status values 0..7 round trip through the On1x adapter
independent C11 and C++17 header inclusion

cross_owner_requests.api: Public ABI 2 host operations for capability_check(host, capability_id), cancellation_poll(host), budget_consume(host, counter, amount), handle_validate(host, id, owner, kind, state), diagnostic_emit(host, const On1xSDK_DiagnosticV2 *), candidate_open(host, schema, revision, limit, out_id), candidate_write_u8(host, id, value), candidate_commit(host, id), and candidate_abort(host, id), each in an abi_version/struct_size-negotiated host table.
cross_owner_requests.reason: Replace the owned trusted scalar bridge without exposing pointers to On1x and retain observable sink/cleanup failures.
cross_owner_requests.migration: Generate reviewed scalar wrappers over these host-approved callbacks; delete _Trusted.on1x declarations only after equivalent negative/lifecycle tests pass.

cross_owner_requests.api: On1xSDK_Status on1x_sdk_source_snapshot_open(const On1xSDK_Host *, On1xSDK_Handle source, uint32_t schema, uint64_t maximum_bytes, On1xSDK_Handle *out); plus revision, byte_length, read_u8, retain and release accessors.
cross_owner_requests.reason: The reference bridge currently copies an immutable source snapshot into fixed host storage. A canonical revision-bound source snapshot is needed before this can consume compiler sessions.

cross_owner_requests.api: A stable scalar AOT export descriptor with abi_version, struct_size, module ABI, function ID, exact (u64,u32)->u32 signature, and an invoke operation that catches all runtime failure without exposing the compiler-generated on1x_fn_* symbol.
cross_owner_requests.reason: module_adapter.c is deliberately pinned to the current generated C symbol and is not a stable runtime/module ABI.

cross_owner_requests.api: Explicit ABI-v1 descriptor adapters in the public ABI 2 registry, preserving statuses 0..7 and synchronous v1 behavior without reading a v1 layout as v2.
cross_owner_requests.reason: The On1x-native layer preserves and tests v1 status numerics, but full v1 descriptor adaptation is outside Subagent 8 ownership.

unsupported: Raw pointers, addresses, allocator tokens, callbacks, foreign resources, and arbitrary implementation-name resolution in safe On1x values
Plugin self-certified contracts, safety, capability grants, revisions, diagnostics, repairs, or artifacts
In-process DSO, isolated native worker, and WASM activation for this On1x module
Structured AST/HIR/MIR traversal or candidate publication
Thread-shared bridge use; the trusted profile is serialized and thread-confined
General native plugin ABI stability; the adapter is rebuilt with the canonical compiler
TSan: no multithreaded execution is admitted by this profile
